spans.s:
r. 1st cl. (अकति)
To wind or move tortuously.
With an indicatory इ। अकि
(अंकति)
1 To mark or bespot.
2 To go. See अङ्क.

m. (-कः)
1 Moving tortuously.
2 One who goes crookedly.
3 Pain, affliction.
4 Sin.
E.
अ priv. and क happiness, or अक to move crookedly, aff. अच्.

f. (-क्का)
A mother.
E.
अक pain, कै to sound.

m. (-चः)
Name of KETU, the dragon's tail, or descending node.
mfn. (-चः-चा-चं)
Bald, destitute of hair.
E.
अ priv. and कच hair: this applies to KETU, as the symbol of the asterism is a headless trunk.

mfn. (-कः-का-कं)
Free from thorns, literally or metaphorically.
E.
अ priv. कण्टक a thorn.

mfn. (-थ्यः-थ्या-थ्यं)
Not to be mentioned or spoken of; also similar forms as अकयनीय &c.
E.
अ neg. कथ to speak, with the participial affixes यत् अनीयर् &c.

m. (-ष्ठः)
A deified saint according to the Bauddhas.
mfn. (-ष्ठः-ष्ठा-ष्ठं)
Elder, superior.
E.
अ priv. and कनिष्ठ youngest.

m. (-गः)
A deified saint according to the Bauddhas.
E.
अकनिष्ठ superior and गम to go; affix ड.

m. (-तः)
The name of a Jaina saint, one of the pupils of the last Tīrthakara.
mfn. (-तः-ता-तं)
Firm, unshaken, not agitated or trembling.
E.
अ priv. कपि to tremble; the participial affix क्त, and इट् inserted.

mfn. (-तः-ता-तं)
Shaken, trembling.
E.
आङ् prefixed, कपि to shake, and क्त participial aff.

mfn. (-रः-रा-री-रं)
1 Maimed, handless.
2 Privileged, exempt from tax or duty.
3 One who does not act.
E.
अ priv. and कर the hand, tax, duty.
f. (-रा)
Emblic myrobalan, (Phyllanthus emblica.)
E.
अ priv. and कृञ to injure, अन् affix.

m. (-रः)
1 A mine.
2 A multitude.
3 Best, excellent.
E.
आङ् prefixed, कृ to make, &c. अप् aff.

m. (-रः)
1 Hint, sign, token.
2

Form.
3

The letter आ.
E.
आङ्, कृ to make, affix घञ्.

m. (-णिः)
Failure, disappointment, (it is used only as an imprecation,) as तस्याकरणिरेवास्तु may he fail.
E.
अ priv. कृञ to do, and अनि affix.

mfn. (-यः-या-यं)
Not to be done, improper or impracticable.
E.
अ neg. करणीय to be done.

mfn. (-णः-णा-णं)
Unfeeling, void of compassion or tenderness.
E.
अ neg. करुणा tenderness.

mfn. (-शः-शा-शं)
Soft, not hard.
E.
अ priv. and कर्क्कश hard.

mfn. (-र्णः-र्णा-र्णं)
Deaf.
E.
अ priv. and कर्ण the ear.

mfn. (-नः-ना-नं)
A dwarf.

mfn. (-व्यः-व्या-व्यं)
Not to be done, improper, impracticable.
E.
अ neg. कर्त्तव्य to be done.

mfn. (-ण्यः-ण्या-ण्यं)
Not to be done, improper.
E.
अ neg. कर्म्मन् act, यत् aff.

mfn. (-र्म्मा-र्म्मा-र्म्म)
1 Idle, unoccupied, without work.
2 Degraded, no longer performing essential rites.
n. (-र्म्म)
1 Absence of occupation.
2 Loss or neglect of essential observances.
3 Improper act, crime, offence.
E.
अ neg. कर्म्मन् act.

mfn. (-कृत्)
Free from action, necessary as vital, or essential as religious.
E.
अ neg. कर्म्म act, कृत् who does.

mfn. (-क्लः-ल्का-ल्कं)
1 Clear, clean.
2 Pure, sinless.
3 Free from sediment.
f. (-ल्का)
Moonlight.
E.
अ priv. and कल्क dirt.

mfn. (-नः-ना-नं)
Humble, not proud, (this word is sometimes written अकल्कल.)
E.
अ priv. कल्क pride, and न or ल aff.

mfn. (-तः-ता-तं)
Natural, not artificial, not made.
E.
अ neg. कल्पित made.

mfn. (-षः-षा-षं)
Faultless, sinless.
E.
अ priv. कल्मष sin.

mfn. (-ल्यः-ल्या-ल्यं)
Sick, diseased.
E.
अ priv. कल्य well.

mfn. (-णः-णी-णं)
Unlucky, inauspicious.
E.
अ neg. कल्याण prosperous.

ind.
1 Immediately, instantly, presently.
2 Without a cause, without a wherefore.
E.
अ neg. कस्मात् from what.

mfn. (-ण्डः-ण्डा-ण्डं)
Sudden, unexpected.
E.
अ neg. काण्ड a stem.

mfn. (-तः-ता-तं)
Suddenly born or produced.
E.
अकाण्ड and जात born.

mfn. (-तः-ता-तं)
Perishing suddenly after birth, dying as soon as born.
E.
अकाण्ड, and पात perishing, जात born.

n. (-णं)
Absence or non-existence of a cause. (Used adverbially,) Causelessly.
E.
अ neg. कारण cause.

nf. (-णं-णा)
Calling, a call or summons.
E.
आङ, कृ to make or do in the causal form, and ल्यु affix, fem. affix टाप्; sometimes written आकरण.

mfn. (-न्नः-न्ना-न्नं)
Born or produced without a cause.
E.
अकारण and उत्पन्न born.

mfn. (-र्य्यः-र्य्या-र्य्यं)
Improper not to be done.
n. (र्य्यं)
An improper act.
E.
अ neg. कार्य्य to be done.

m. (-लः)
Irregular or unusual, as time or season.
E.
अ neg. काल time.

m. (-मंः)
A flower budding out of season.
E.
अकाल and कुमुम a flower.

mfn. (-जः-जा-जं)
Unseasonable, produced out of time or season; also अकालजात, अकालोत्पन्न and similar compounds.
E.
अकाल with ज or जात &c. born or produced.

m. (-यः)
1 A fog, or mist.
2 Unseasonable gathering of clouds.
E.
अ priv. and काल time, जलट् a cloud, and उदय rising.

m. (-यः)
1 Unseasonable cloudiness.
2 A fog or mist.
E.
अकाल with मेघ a cloud, and उदय rising.

mfn. (-हः-हा-हं)
Impatient, premature, not waiting for the proper season.
E.
अ neg. कालसह time-enduring.

n. (-नं)
Shaking, trembling.
E.
आङ् before कपि to tremble, ल्युट् aff.

mfn. (-म्प्रः-म्प्रा-म्प्रं)
Trembling, shaking, agitated.
E.
आङ् before कपि to shake; रक aff.

mfn. (-री-रिणी-रि)
Mineral, produced in a mine, &c.
E.
आकर and इनि aff.

n. (-नं)
Hearing.
E.
आङ् before कर्ण to hear, ल्युट् aff.

mfn. (-तः-ता-तं)
Heard.
E.
आङ् कर्ण to hear, affix क्त.

m. (-र्षः)
1 Pulling, hauling^1.
2 Pulling to or towards, dragging, attracting.
3 Attraction, fascination.
4 Magnetic attraction.
5 A magnet, a loadstone.
6 A dice or die.
7 Playing with dice.
8 A board for such a game.
9 Drawing the bow.
10 An organ of sense.
11 Spasm.
E.
आङ्, कृष to draw or make furrows, घञ् aff.
[1] Correction submitted by Dr. Sampada Savardekar on 20210731. Reference: https://github.com/sanskrit-lexicon/csl-corrections/issues/66.

mfn. (-कः-की-कं)
Attractive, what draws or attracts.
m. (-कः)
A magnet or loadstone.
E.
आकर्ष attraction, and वुन् aff.

n. (-णं)
Pulling, drawing, attracting.
f. (-णी)
1 A crooked stick, for pulling down fruit, &c.
2 Any instrument for pulling.
E.
आङ् before कृष to pull, ल्युट् aff.

mfn. (-कः-की-कं)
Magnetic, attractive.
E.
आकर्ष and ष्ठल aff.

mfn. (-तः-ता-तं)
Drawn, attracted.
E.
आङ् before कृष to draw, क्त aff.

mfn. (-र्षी-र्षिणी-र्षि)
Attractive.
f. (-णी)
A rod with a hook at the end to pull down the boughs of trees, for the purpose of gathering the fruit.
E.
आङ् before कृष to draw, णिनि aff.

n. (-नं)
1 Wish, desire.
2 Counting, reckoning.
3 Confinement, binding.
4 Laying hold of.
E.
आङ्, कल to count, sound, &c. and ल्युट् aff.

mfn. (-तः-ता-तं)
1 Counted, reckoned.
2 Seized, held, bound.
E.
आङ्ग before कल to count, &c. क्त aff.

m. (-ल्पः)
1 Ornament, decoration.
2 Encreasing, adding to, improving.
3 Sickness, disease.
E.
आङ् before कृप to be able, to be weak, &c. घञ् aff.

m. (-कः)
1 Remembering with regret, missing.
2 Fainting, loss of sense or perception.
4

Darkness.
4

A knot or joint.
E.
आङ्, कल्प from कृप to be able, to be weak, &c. and ण्वुल् aff.

m. (-षः)
A touchstone.
E.
आङ्, कष to injure, and अच aff.

mn. (-शः-शं)
1 The fifth element, aether, the sky or atmosphere.
2 Brahma as identical with aether.
3 Space, vacuity.
E.
आङ् and काशृ to shine, घञ् affix; every where shining; Ākāśa is the subtle and ethereal^1 fluid, supposed to fill and pervade the universe, and to be the peculiar vehicle of life and sound.
[1] Correction submitted by Dr. Sampada Savardekar on 20210731. Reference: https://github.com/sanskrit-lexicon/csl-corrections/issues/66.

mfn. (-कः-का-कं)
Touching, assaying.
E.
वुन् added to the last.

mfn. (-कः-की-कं)
Touching, testing.
E.
आकष and ष्ठल aff.

mfn. (-कः-की-कं)
Sudden, unexpected, causeless.
E.
अक स्मात् and ठञ् aff.

mfn. (-ङ्क्षन्-ङ्क्ष-अन्ती-ङ्क्षत्)
1 Wishing, expecting.
2 Looking at, to, or towards.
E.
आङ् before काङ्क्षि to desire, शतृ aff.

mfn. (-यः-या-यं)
Desirable, to be desired or expected.
E.
आङ् before काक्षि to desire, अनीयर् affix; also आकाङ्क्षितब्य (-ब्यः-ब्या-ब्यं) and आकाङ्ख्य (-ङ्ख्यः-ङ्ख्या-ङ्ख्यं) with तब्य or यत् affs.

f. (-ङ्क्षा)
1 Wish, desire.
2 Purpose, intention.
3 Looking at, to, or towards.
4 Enquiry, asking.
5 The presence of a word in a sentence indispensable to the sense.
6 The significancy of a word.
E.
आङ् prefixed to काक्षि to desire, अच् and टाप् aff.

mfn. (-तः-ता-तं)
1 Wished, desired.
2 Asked, enquired.
3 Regarded, looked at.
4 Wanted, necessary.
E.
आङ् before काङ्क्षि to desire, क्त aff.

mfn. (-ङ्क्षी-ङ्क्षिणी-ङ्क्षि)
1 Wishing, wishful.
2 Asking, enquiring, expectant.
E.
आकाङ्क्षा and इनि aff.

m. (-यः)
1 A funeral pile.
2 Abode, residence.
E.
आङ् before चि to collect, घञ् affix, च changed to क.

f. (-प्तिः)
Dissimulation.
E.
आकार and गुप्ति concealment, suppressing all sign or indication of the feelings.

n. (-नं)
See the preceding.

mfn. (-वान्-वती-वत्)
Symmetrical, handsome, well formed.
E.
आकार form, and मतुप् aff.

mfn. (-तः-ता-तं)
1 Called, summoned.
2 Stipulated, agreed.
3 Demanded, exacted.
E.
आङ् before कृ to make, causal form, क्त aff.

mfn. (-कः-की-कं)
1 Momentary, instantaneous.
2 Unseasonable, improper with respect to time.
f. (-की)
Lightning.
E.
अ neg. काल time, ठक् affix, fem. ङीप्.

n. (-त्वं)
Unseasonableness, suddenness.
E.
त्व added to the last.

f. (-क्षा)
The horizon.
E.
आकाश and कक्षा girdle.

mfn. (-जः-जा-जं)
Produced in the sky.
E.
आकाश and ज born.

m. (-नी)
A loop-hole, a casement, an embrasure.
E.
आकाश and जनविन् what generates, giving air and light.

m. (-पः)
1 A lamp or torch lighted in honour of LAKṢMI or VIṢṆU, and elevated on a pole in the open air at the Dewali festival, in the month

Kartik.
2

A beacon, a lanthorn on a pole.
E.
आकाश and दीप a lamp; also आकाशप्रदीपः.

n. (-तं)
1 Speaking outside or off the stage, or a suppositious speech, which is replied to as if it had been spoken, (in dramatic language.)
3 A voice or sound in the air.
E.
आकाश and भाषित spoken.

n. (-लं)
The celestial sphere.
E.
आकाश and मण्डल a circle.

f. (-सी)
A plant, small Jaṭāmāṃsī, (Valeriana Jatamansi.)

f. (-ली)
An aquatic plant, (Pistia stratiotes.)
E.
आकाश and मूली having roots; having its root in air.

n. (-नं)
A heavenly car, one moving through the air.
E.
आकाश and यान vehicle.

m. (-क्षी)
A warder, a watchman on the outer battlements.
E.
आकाश and रक्षिन् a guard.

n. (-र्त्म)
The atmosphere, the firmament, the air.
E.
आकाश and वर्त्मन् a road.

f. (-ल्ली)
A sort of creeper, a parasite, (Cassyta filiformis.)
E.
आकाश and वल्ली pedicle.

f. (-णी)
A voice from heaven.
E.
आकाश and वाणी speech.

n. (-लं)
Rain.
E.
आकाश and सलिल water.

mfn. (-स्थः-स्था-स्थं)
Abiding in the sky.
E.
आकाश and स्थ what stays.

mfn. (-यः-या-यं)
Atmospherical. Also आकाशिन् mfn. (-शी-शिनी-शि).

ind.
In the air, a stage direction, implying something said by or to a person out of sight.
th case of आकाश.

m. (-शः)
1 INDRA, as ruler of the firmament.
2 (In law) A helpless person, as a child, a woman, a pauper or invalid.
E.
आकाश and ईश lord.
